subject: FY22 Middle School Lottery Drawing
overview: District administrators conducted the annual random lottery to assign incoming sixth-grade students to either McGlynn or Andrews Middle School. Due to technical issues with the district website, officials announced results would be distributed via social media and email.

items.title: Introduction and Orientation Schedule
items.summary: Administrators introduced the lottery team and announced middle school orientation dates for May 10 and May 12.

items.title: Brooks School Lottery
items.summary: The district completed two rounds of random drawings for students from the Brooks Elementary School.

items.title: McGlynn School Lottery
items.summary: The administration finalized two lottery draws for students attending McGlynn Elementary.

items.title: Missituk School Lottery
items.summary: Officials conducted the two required lottery draws for students from the Missituk Elementary School.

items.title: Roberts School Lottery
items.summary: The final two lottery drawings were completed for students from Roberts Elementary School.

items.title: Result Notification and Closing
items.summary: Staff confirmed that lottery results would be scanned and posted to the district Facebook page and emailed to families while the city website remained offline for service.
